title: Multiplayer Structural Load Stress Visualization
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive multiplayer structural load stress visualization for a bridge structure. Load the 'robot.glb' asset using GLTFLoader from the Three.js CDN addons — this robot model represents an inspection drone that can be positioned on the bridge to add localized load.

SCENE SETUP:
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 12, 25), looking at origin. Enable OrbitControls.
- Lighting: DirectionalLight at (5, 15, 10) intensity 1.2, AmbientLight intensity 0.4, and a HemisphereLight(0x87ceeb, 0x444444, 0.5).
- Ground plane: 60x60 gray plane at y=0.
- Bridge structure: Build a parametric truss bridge spanning from x=-15 to x=15, y=2 to y=6, z=-2 to z=2. The bridge consists of:
  * 2 horizontal deck beams (bottom chords) at y=2, z=-1.5 and z=1.5, made of BoxGeometry segments.
  * 2 top chords at y=6, z=-1.5 and z=1.5.
  * Vertical members connecting top and bottom chords every 3 units along x (11 verticals per side).
  * Diagonal cross-bracing between verticals on each side.
  * A flat deck surface (thin box) at y=2 spanning the full bridge.
  * Each structural member is a separate Mesh stored in an array. Use MeshStandardMaterial with base color #708090 (steel gray).
- Support pillars: 4 cylindrical pillars at the four corners of the bridge (x=-15, x=15, z=-1.5, z=1.5) from y=0 to y=2.
- Load the robot.glb model, scale it to 1.5, and place it initially at (0, 6.2, 0) on top of the bridge. This is the 'inspection drone'.

PHYSICS / STRESS MODEL:
- Implement a simplified finite-element-inspired stress calculation system.
- Each structural member has properties: { id, stress: 0, maxStress: 100, deformation: 0, material }.
- Define a 'load points' system: an array of up to 6 load points, each with { id, position: Vector3, force: number (in kN), active: boolean, playerId: string }.
- The stress at each member is calculated based on proximity to active load points: stress = sum over all active loads of (force / (1 + distance^2)) where distance is from the member center to the load point.
- Deformation of each member = stress / maxStress * 0.15 (max visual sag in y).
- Color-code members by stress ratio (stress/maxStress): 0-0.3 green (#00ff00), 0.3-0.6 yellow (#ffff00), 0.6-0.85 orange (#ff8800), 0.85-1.0 red (#ff0000), >1.0 flashing red (toggle every 300ms).
- Total structural integrity = 100 - (average stress ratio across all members * 100). Clamp to [0, 100].
- If any member exceeds maxStress, mark the structure as 'CRITICAL'.
- Conservation rule: total applied force must equal sum of reaction forces at the 4 supports. Track reactionForces as an array of 4 numbers distributed proportionally by inverse distance from each load to each support.

MULTIPLAYER SIMULATION:
- Simulate 3 players: 'Player1' (color #ff4444), 'Player2' (color #4444ff), 'Player3' (color #44ff44).
- The current active player is toggled via a DOM dropdown select element with id='playerSelect'.
- Each player can place load points by clicking on the bridge deck (raycasting). The load point is visualized as a downward arrow (ConeGeometry, color matching player) at the clicked position.
- Each player can have at most 2 load points active simultaneously.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- Click on bridge deck: Place a load point for the active player at the clicked position with default force 20 kN.
- Keyboard 'W'/'S': Increase/decrease the force of the most recently placed load by the active player by 5 kN. Clamp force to [5, 80].
- Keyboard 'D': Delete (deactivate) the most recently placed load by the active player.
- Keyboard 'U': Undo the last action globally (supports up to 10 undo steps). Actions include place, delete, and force changes.
- Keyboard 'R': Redo the last undone action.
- Keyboard 'M': Move the robot.glb drone to the position of the highest-stress member.
- DOM button id='resetAll': Remove all load points and reset stress to zero.
- DOM button id='toggleDeformation': Toggle visual deformation on/off (stress colors still update).
- DOM range slider id='globalMultiplier' (0.5 to 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0): Multiplies all forces by this factor before stress calculation.

HUD / UI:
- Top-left panel (id='hudPanel') showing:
  * 'Structural Integrity: XX.X%' in span id='integrityDisplay'
  * 'Status: SAFE|WARNING|CRITICAL' in span id='statusDisplay' (SAFE if integrity>60, WARNING if 30-60, CRITICAL if <30 or any member over max)
  * 'Active Player: PlayerN' in span id='activePlayerDisplay'
  * 'Total Load: XX.X kN' in span id='totalLoadDisplay'
  * 'Members Over Limit: N' in span id='overLimitDisplay'
- Bottom bar with the controls: playerSelect dropdown, resetAll button, toggleDeformation button, globalMultiplier slider with label showing current value in span id='multiplierValue'.

STATE MANAGEMENT — window.__3D_STATE__ must expose:
{
  members: [ { id, stress, maxStress, deformation, stressRatio, colorHex } ... ],
  loadPoints: [ { id, position: {x,y,z}, force, active, playerId } ... ],
  activePlayer: 'Player1'|'Player2'|'Player3',
  structuralIntegrity: number,
  status: 'SAFE'|'WARNING'|'CRITICAL',
  totalLoad: number,
  membersOverLimit: number,
  reactionForces: [number, number, number, number],
  totalReactionForce: number,
  deformationVisible: boolean,
  globalMultiplier: number,
  robotPosition: {x, y, z},
  undoStackSize: number,
  redoStackSize: number,
  droneAtHighStress: boolean,
  lastAction: string,
  memberCount: number,
  sceneReady: boolean
}

Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Ensure all numerical values are NaN-free (default to 0).
physics_constraints: Stress propagation follows inverse-square-distance from load points to members. Total reaction forces at 4 supports must equal total applied load (conservation of force). Deformation is proportional to stress ratio. All forces clamped to [5, 80] kN per point. Global multiplier scales all forces. Structural integrity is 100 minus average stress ratio percentage. Members exceeding maxStress trigger CRITICAL status.
